headline: Grumpy Walrus bought ~4,751 ASCEND for ~6.2k ADA in 8 buys 9:06-10:08 PM ET (now ~340.7k, biggest single buy ~1,911 for ~2.5k ADA at 9:40 PM), sold another 1M SNEK for ~2.9k ADA (~41M left), made small ~71 ADA buys of COCK, MEPE (x2), SOLADA and a new ATLAS position, and clipped VAL 4 times (~2.25M for ~520 ADA); net ADA ~-4.2k since 8:05 PM. CHARLFG swarm launch (10 coordinated buyers, 4 fresh wallets, 5 snipers already out) plus ICOIN, LEVERHED and NIO coordinated buys, all Swarm group C, all Pass. ASCEND side ~1.144M, STRIKE ~1.198M, FLOW ~655k, COCK ~154.5k. No open tickets; nothing passes k/y.
learned: Lessons: the prefilter payload matched the trace exactly this time (ASCEND +4,751 for 6,216 ADA, net ADA -4,190); its SNEK sale was split across a send and two swaps, so check multi-leg sells before calling them transfers.
